feeds.title: JewishGen Blog
feeds.description: JewishGen serves as the global home for Jewish genealogy. Featuring unparalleled access to millions of records, it offers unique search tools, along with opportunities for researchers to connect with others who share similar interests.

feeds.title: Lara's Jewnealogy
feeds.description: Genealogy tips & stories tracing family with microfilmed records, records in Ukrainian archives, and (sometimes) online records. Jewish genealogy blog

feeds.title: The Ginger Jewish Genealogist Blog
feeds.description: First things first, my name is Banai, like in B'nai Brith, B'nai Israel, B'nai Torah, or any other synagogue name you may know like that. If you've never heard of any of those, it rhymes with Renee.Banai Lynn Feldstein keeps a blog as the Ginger Jewish Genealogist. Her research generally focuses on US, Eastern Europe, and Jewish genealogy. In her blog, she writes mostly about genealogy, but you never know when she'll have something else to say.

feeds.title: Blood and Frogs: Jewish Genealogy and More
feeds.description: A little bit about me. My name is Philip Trauring, and I was born in Brookline, MA. I've also lived in Palo Alto, CA, New York, NY, Jerusalem, Israel, and I am now in Modi'in, Israel. Professionally my field has been high-tech, and I've worked for companies in California, New York, Massachusetts and here in Israel.

feeds.title: Round2it Genealogy
feeds.description: Jeanette's Round2it Genealogy Blog because I have finally got around to having a family history blog to share stories about my own German-Jewish ancestors, research tips and other tales and serendipitous facts that I've picked up along the way.

feeds.title: Jewish Gem's Genealogy
feeds.description: The Jewish Gem's Genealogy shares Information related to Jewish genealogy including names, events, resources, etc.

feeds.title: Layers of the Onion - A Family History Exploration
feeds.description: This blog explores a family history search. It addresses genealogy, Jewish heritage travel and artwork. It has taken the author to Belarus, the Ukraine and Poland where she visited her ancestral towns as well as Lithuania where she studied Yiddish at the Vilnius Yiddish Institute. As the author is both an artist and a genealogist, the blog also addresses her artwork related to her family and cultural history.

feeds.title: Avotaynu Online
feeds.description: Avotaynu Online is a research blog that provides in-depth information about the origins and migration done by the Jewish people.

feeds.title: IAJGS
feeds.description: AJGS by International Association of Jewish Genealogical Societies (IAJGS) is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.

feeds.title: Israel Genealogy Research Association
feeds.description: The Israel Genealogy Research Association is a genealogy society based in Israel that is open to all, and seeks to expand access to records in Israel related to Israel, as well as Jewish records available in Israel that originated in other countries.

feeds.title: Utah Jewish Genealogical Society Blog
feeds.description: The Utah Jewish Genealogical Society is a non-profit organization, founded in 2002 to provide a forum for and assistance to members interested in researching their Jewish ancestors. UJGS Blog offers its members research techniques, and informative lectures, and teaches genealogical research techniques.

feeds.title: Russian Jewish Roots
feeds.description: The Russian Jewish Roots is a Genealogy in the 21st Century website providing valuable information for its readers who want to track down their family information.

feeds.title: The JGSGM Blog
feeds.description: The JGSGM Blog shares information about Jewish families, their history, culture, major past movements, research videos, and more.

feeds.title: My Family Genie Blog
feeds.description: Affordable family research and genealogy services, including DNA testing analysis. Contact My Family Genie for a free initial consultation. Dr. Adina Newman grew up listening to stories about her own ancestors and developed a keen interest in all things history and tradition. Learn about happenings at My Family Genie as well as tips on genealogy and family research through paper trails and DNA in our blog.

feeds.title: Jewish Family Search Blog
feeds.description: Discover your roots in Ukraine & Poland

feeds.title: (going) The Extra Yard
feeds.description: he Extra Yad is a play on English and Hebrew words ('Yad' means hand and is also the name of the pointer used while reading from the Torah scroll) reflecting the several realities of my involvement with Jewish family history.

feeds.title: The Knowles Collection
feeds.description: The Knowles Collection is a blog that shares information for a Jewish family reader who wants to understand his community root and wants to connect with his Jewish familes.

feeds.title: Synagogue Scribes Jewish Genealogy Blog
feeds.description: Synagogue Scribes Blog Posts related to Synagogue Scribes entries. Success stories, information, items of interest and more.

feeds.title: Minnesota Jewish Geneological Society Blog
feeds.description: The MN Jewish Genealogical Society helps you uncover your family history, learn about your roots, and connect with a community of history seekers.

feeds.title: Ancestral Discoveries
feeds.description: Genealogy is like a jigsaw puzzle, but you don't have the box top, so you don't know what the picture is supposed to look like. As you start putting the puzzle together, you realize some pieces are missing, and eventually you figure out that some of the pieces you started with don't actually belong to this puzzle. I'll help you discover the right pieces for your puzzle and assemble them into a picture of your family.

feeds.title: A Jewish Genealogy Journey
feeds.description: Follow Jewish Genealogy Journey, filter it, and define how you want to receive the news (via Email, RSS, Telegram, WhatsApp etc.) I have been researching my family history since before 1990. See my family history blog at From Maine to Kentucky where I blog about my ancestry.
